title: STNFS with nested 384-cell quadrature and 1/1024 Dickman brackets: 121.9996

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, the complete STNFS algorithm in proof.md and DESCENT.md with the numerical refinement in REFINEMENT.md returns Q satisfying e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P, with success at least 0.391663 (and hence at least 0.39) under disclosed heuristics H1-H5. It computes two GT logarithms and returns Q=[a]Q0, handling z=1 directly. All classical work is bounded by a global meter at 2^121.9996 dense-Fp12-multiplication equivalents, C=20,000 instructions, with an upper-rounded complete ledger below 2^121.99951. The physical lattice plan, polynomials, prime windows, relation region theta=87/200, factor-base bound, work allowance1.0549, filtering, kernels and target remain those of the cited source. Nested lower sums use384 cells, rho brackets use1/1024, iA indices scale by8, TRUNC=0, and retention uses the same global mesh. Expected two-log work is bounded by2^117.9578; the two-log meter is2^118.6803. Markov abort probability is below0.60604634 and the retained conservative0.6060858. Other retained upper bounds are boot failure1.9830e-4 per log, expected nodes2^17.66, node abort2^-9.64 and repeats2^-10.70, with2/r statistical distance charged. All preprocessing, failed attempts, advice construction, arithmetic, transfers, sorting, verification and output are included; nothing is amortized over other targets. Numerical-certificate construction receives an extra2^50-unit allowance. Memory is at most2^105 bytes. The source smoothness and production extrapolations remain explicit heuristics; no favorable finite-density correction or unsupported independence of whole logarithms is asserted. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.
